segmentler.metin: Eastern Air Lines Flight 212 crashed short of the runway at Charlotte.
It took only a crew distracted by idle conversation during approach.
So how could a crew distracted by idle conversation during approach do this?
The answer is descent below safe altitude while the crew failed to monitor instruments — and it is why the sterile cockpit rule banned non-essential talk during critical phases.
